description: Dwelling Estimates Interactive Map is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts (DITRDCA). The insight uses the ABS’s dwelling stock data to present estimates of Total Dwellings (Houses, Townhouses, and Apartments) for the 2016 to 2022 period. Coverage is Australia, 2016 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-08-06. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is other open licence (terms not stated in the catalogue). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
